text: The breaking change this week is #13759, which removes CLEAN27 obsolete code across W1 and regional apps, including 140 deleted AL files, so extensions that still reference those objects, such as the Advance Letter CZZ pages and table, need updating. Among behaviour changes, #9587 adds concurrent posting for General Ledger entries, touching G/L posting codeunits and ledger and register tables, though its description gives little detail. Posting and finance fixes include #13482 and #13805, which align Non-Deductible VAT amounts in purchase invoice statistics with VAT and G/L entries, #12770 for project ledger entries and modified invoice discounts, #13628 for drop shipment reference fields on receipt lines, #13861 for dispute status on Cust. Ledger Entry, and #13225 for FEC export columns. Country fixes: #13616 relaxes SWIFT code validation in Czech tables. Other fixes: #13778 for production order component dimensions from Order Planning, #13724 for warehouse picks on make-to-order subassemblies, #13855 so 0 can be saved as a decimal item attribute, #13607 for report 713 Excel export, and #13572 so cloud migration deletes the correct hybrid company. Expense Agent work covers #13499, #13730, #13672 and #12670, plus #13792, which adds a missing field without changing behaviour. Two more changes add no behaviour: #12084 adds Subcontracting telemetry, and #13765 sets a maximum output token budget for E-Document MLLM extraction.

issues: The paragraph said 'Two changes add no behaviour' (#12084, #13765), but #13792 also has no behaviour flag. It was listed with the Expense Agent work without saying so, which made the count misleading. The corrected text now marks #13792 as having no behaviour change.
Minor: #13759 also has no behaviour flag. It is already described as the breaking obsoletion, so this does not need changing.
